name: CallMissed
description: CallMissed provides signup credits for its model API, not a recurring credit grant.
overview: CallMissed advertises 1,000 signup credits on its free plan, with 100 LLM calls per month and 60 requests per minute. Its pricing page states that usage spends credits and that the free plan has no monthly credit grant, so the monthly call cap is not a recurring free balance. The vendor says signup does not require a card.
free_access: Free plan capped at 100 LLM calls/month
Usage spends credits; no monthly credit grant
notes: Trial credits are finite. Check the live model catalog and prices before use.
